channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Will Barton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Will Barton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Will Barton
item.description:
Nurse on Barton signing:

“He can play screen and roll and obviously shoot the three, those two things obviously should help us.”

Nick Nurse on Will Barton, Feb 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton
item.description:
Katy Winge:Coach Malone on the Barton/Boogie altercation:

“That was out of our system before we got on the plane.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Apr 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Will Barton
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins & Will Barton having an argument:

“If we're fragmented, if we're breaking off into groups or individuals, then we have zero chance of winning a game in this series.”

Michael Malone on DeMarcus Cousins, Will Barton, Apr 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris
item.description:
Not only is he on track to become the first player in league history to average at least 25 points, 13 rebounds and six assists per game, but also he’s making his teammates better along the way.

“I think the beauty of basketball is there is always someone who is going to step up — Monte (Morris), AG (Aaron Gordon), Will Barton,”

Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Feb 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton
item.description:
Michael Malone on Will Barton:

“Of course I hope he's back...he means a ton to me personally. He means a ton to this team.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jun 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Will Barton
item.description:
Nikola Jokic:

“I'm just hoping no one else is going to get injured...we’re missing Jamal, Monte, Will Barton, all really good pick-and-roll players, team players. We will see what we can do. It’s opportunity for someone else to step up and play.”

Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Barton:

“You can look at it both ways. ... There's certain things that Will Barton brings to our team that other guys just can't do. ... Also allowed us to take a look at Jerami Grant as our starting SF.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jerami Grant, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Gary Harris, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Singer:Malone on Murray, Barton or Harris’ availability:

“Keep hope alive ... Maybe one of those guys, but very very questionable.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Gary Harris, Jamal Murray, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Seth Curry on Will Barton
item.description:
Seth Curry on the Barton eye poke:

“He waited for a few people to get in between us, and when a few people were in between us he put his finger in my eye. I can't allow people to put their fingers in my eye. That's real sassy. They got some sassy dudes over there. Frontrunners.”

Seth Curry on Will Barton, May 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“Some guys when they’re out and they’re not playing, they’re okay with that. We have two guys in Will Barton and Isaiah Thomas, it’s killing both of those guys not to be able to play.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Isaiah Thomas, Dec 2, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Will Barton, Monte Morris, Sue Bird
item.description:
#Nuggets POBO, Tim Connelly, on Bird:

“We're always trying to find unique perspectives. ...It was really neat when she came to a few of our practices. Will Barton came to her and said 'Legend.' Monte Morris exchanged info to get her thoughts on how to play the PG position.”

Tim Connelly on Will Barton, Monte Morris, Sue Bird, Nov 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Will Barton
item.description:
Nikola on Barton’s absence:

“We’re gonna miss him, especially in the locker room... On the court, he’s a big bucket machine.”

Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Oct 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Will Barton
item.description:
Gina Mizell:Tim Connelly on Will Barton's unrestricted free agency:

“We’re hopeful we can get something done. He’s our guy. We love him. I think if he’s back in a Denver jersey, it’s good for both him and the team.”

Tim Connelly on Will Barton, Apr 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton
item.description:
“We needed that, man. Will Barton is a very important piece, we all know that. Since the break he just hasn’t found his groove and tonight you see him shoot the ball as well as he did from three, being the playmaker he was,”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Mar 15, 2017. Source: BSN Denver.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton
item.description:
“Us losing to Portland was not on Will Barton. I told him, I appreciate him saying that and trying to take responsibility for that, but I also wanted to reassure him that we didn’t lose that game because of him. It’s not his responsibility to take that on himself.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Jan 6, 2016. Source: Denver Post.
